batting.dismissal: c TM Dilshan b A Mishra

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c B Geeves b VY Mahesh

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c TM Dilshan b B Geeves

batting.name: SD Chitnis
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b VY Mahesh

batting.name: PR Shah
batting.dismissal: c B Geeves b VY Mahesh

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b A Nel

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c SD Chitnis b DR Smith

balls.text: Dropped: He makes room and tries to club this one over midwicket, Sehwag drops a sitter at midwicket and that allows a single, Nel dashes out for a second run but Uthappa isn't interested
wow! Yomahesh bowls the slow legcutter but Uthappa stays at the crease, picks the slower ball early and scoops it high over the bowler's head, all timing
take that! Yomahesh bowls a low full toss and Uthappa bludgeons it while staying at the crease, the ball clears long-on by quite distance and lands a few rows back
Yomahesh takes his fourth! Pinal Shah tries to improvise by walking across his stumps for the paddle scoop, he doesn't get the distance as Geeves runs across from short fine leg to take the catch
bowls a much fuller length this time, he pushes it through the line to long-off
bangs in what looks like a slow bouncer, Chitnis takes a couple of paces out of his crease and pulls, the elevation isn't quite there as Dhawan takes it just ahead of the rope at deep square leg
fullish outside off, he makes room and digs it out to sweeper cover
it's a waist high full toss! He steps down the track and pulls it to deep midwicket
takes a few paces down the track and clubs away a short delivery past midwicket, this is turning out to be an expensive over for Delhi
great improvisation by Uthappa as he walks across his stumps and paddles away a low full toss over short fine leg
fires that full outside the offstump, it was almost on a yorker length when he went forward for the stroke, he manages a thick outside edge which beats the keeper
gets it to swing away and land on a yorker length, he mistimes his drive gets an inside edge onto his boot
walks down the pitch and pushes a full swinging delivery down to long-off
slides on the pads, he rolls his wrists and tucks it wide of midwicket
good length outside the offstump, he pushes to long-off

middle stump goes for a wit goes walk! Pollock makes room to pull over the on side but the ball comes on a lot slower than he would have expected, it goes on straight through and takes out the middle stump
Pollock makes room to drive down the ground but he gets a streaky under edge which trickles past the stumps and beats short fine leg
fires in a fuller delivery outside off and he squeezes it out to point again
stays back at the crease but he gets a slower delivery and he pushes that wide of point
takes a couple of paces forward and places a low full toss down to midwicket
makes room again and carves a full delivery swinging away from him down to third man, Mishra scampers to stop that but the ball just beats him on the dive
makes a bit of room and gets a thin under edge which beats the stumps and the keeper, short fine leg runs back and cuts it off
the length is slightly short but the pull is mistimed to midwicket
angles it towards his body this time and he tucks it behind square on the on side
makes room to slice it wide of gully but he misses
charges down the track and lofts it with intent doen to long-off, the fielder takes it just before the rope
leans forward and drives to sweeper cover
slides on the pads, he whips it to midwicket
leans forward and drives to sweeper cover
good stuff from Uthappa! Geeves slants it away from the right hander and he opens the face of the bat, picks his spot and deliberately glides it wide of third man, no slip in place as well
overpitches on middle and leg and Uthappa takes his chances with the loft, he scoops it through the line and just gets enough elevation to clear mid-on
driven to mid-off
angles it down to backward point
very soft dismissal! Geeves slips in a full toss and Nayar gets into the stroke very early, he mistimes the swing across the line completely and Dilshan takes an easy catch at mid-on
he bowls the googly on seeing him charge down the track, he adjusts and dabs it to short third man
pushed back to the bowler
dangerous ploy by Uthappa as he stays back to a flipper, yet he manages to punch it past the bowler, had he missed that would have crashed onto the stumps
Aren't Delhi thrilled with that! Mishra flights it outside the offstump, Jayasuriya gives him the charge but lofts it inside out, he tried to clear long-off but Dilshan ran across and took it easily
flighted outside off, he leans forward and drives to backward point
floats it on the pads and he works it through the line wide of midwicket
he gets off the mark finally by shuffling across and tucking a good length delivery angled across him down to square leg
he teases him with another slower one which beats him outside the offstump, Uthappa hasn't been in the best of form of late and he's been very tentative off the three balls he's faced today
gets a half stride forward and softly taps it back to the bowler
bangs in the bouncer and catches a circumspect Uthappa off guard, it was in fact the slow bouncer as he moved across his stumps and withdrew his stroke
probably attempting a yorker there, the ball slips out and Jayasuriya clubs a high full toss to deep square leg

Yomahesh deceives him with a slow offcutter, Smith tries to launch him downtown but fails to pick the pace of the ball, he plants his front foot forward and gets a thick top edge and Geeves takes it at mid-off pedalling backwards
rocks back to a shortish delivery and works it wide of midwicket for a couple
shot of the day so far! Mishra bangs it short  but it;s the wrong length to bowl, Jayasuriya rocks back and bludgeons it plenty of rows back over deep midwicket
gets down for the sweep early and mows it wide of square leg
leans forward and drives this one to long-off, that travelled quickly
gets forward to a full delivery and places it firmly to long-off
pushed to the covers
full outside off, he drives to the offside
crack! Geeves errs by drifting wide outside the offstump, he makes room and plays a booming square cut past backward point
short outside off, he shapes to pull but mistimes it to long-on
classic! He pitches it on a full length on the pads, he walks across the stumps and paddles it well clear of short fine leg, wasn't a bad ball, just a clever shot
hits a good length outside off and he punches it wide of cover
slants it across the right hander and pitches it up on the pads, Smith whips it across the line and clears midwicket comfortably
bowls it fuller and faster, he drives to mid-off
angles into the pads, he works it wide of midwicket

Appeal: Mishra foxes him with a sharp googly and the ball hits his back leg as he prods forward to defend, Mishra and Karthik were certain that was plumb but Bowden wasn't so sure, may have missed leg I guess

bang! But for a single, he pitches it short and Jayasuriya generates tremendous bat speed and clubs it across the line over midwicket, de Villiers who's subbing for someone else takes it on the first bounce
just opens the face of the bat and steers it to point
flighted on the pads, he drives inside out to mid-off
bowls a full and slow delivery on the pads and he works it wide of square leg to bring up his fifty
opens the face of the bat and deliberately glides it wide of the keeper, Smith wants the second run but Jayasuriya sends him back
slides down the legside again and Karthik picks it up and whips off the bails
slides down the legside and Karthik who's upto the stumps picks it up
picks the slower ball and pushes it down towards mid-off
moves across just a touch and turns it to midwicket, he thinks of a run but Jayasuriya sends him back
shuffles at the crease, rolls his wrists and tucks a good length ball wide of midwicket
stays back to a good length ball and punches it back to the bowler
gets it to slant across the left hander and still manages to tuck him for room , he drives wide of mid-off for a single
tucks up the left hander this time as he cramps him for room, he drives  very close to the body and places it to mid-on
slides on the pads and he tucks it behind square on the on side to get off the mark
timber! Yomahesh pitches it on middle and gets it to nip back in, Tendulkar tries to flick it to the on side but the ball skids through a lot quicker than expected and pushes his legstump back

Appeal: He fails to pick the slower ball and gets into the pull rather early, Maharoof was super confident the ball went through straight and struck him on the pads in line with the stump but the umpire reckoned he got an inside edge, that was mighty close
fires in the yorker this time and Jayasuriya can only push it softly down to mid-off
fails to control the movement and slides it wide down the legside
the bowler gets sway with one this time as he slides on the pads and Jayasuriya can't whip it wide of short fine leg
good comeback by Maharoof as he jams it on the blockhole
effortless! He bowls a good length ball on middle and Jayasuriya gets a stride forward and swings  effortlessly across the line and clears deep square leg
stumping chance! He slides wide down the legstump and Tendulkar trods out of his crease as he tries to flick it, Karthik fumbles and lets it slip through
slides on the pads, he tucks it to midwicket
bowls the slower ball outside leg, he tries to paddle it away fine but misses
shuffles across his stumps, the ball pitches outside the line of legstump and traps him high on the pad, Maharoof appeals
streaky, but he'll take it, full and wide outside the offstump and Jayasuriya flashes at one well away from his body, the outside edge flies past the diving Karthik and travels to third man
he bowls this fuller but continues to err by bowling wide outside off, Jayasuriya hits through the line and scoops it high over deep extra cover
an invitation to hit! That was short and wide outside the offstump, Jayasuriya makes use of the width and slices it over third man, that would have been a six on any ground
he shuffles his backfoot before the delivery to disturb the bowler's rhythm, well Yomahes keeps him quiet as Jayasuriya places it to point
nearly had him there! Tendulkar leans forward for the drive early and punches it in front of mid-off, Dhawan gathers it and takes aim and a direct hit would have sent Tendulkar back surely
pitches outside off, he leans into the drive and works it wide of backward point
opens the face of the bat and angles a full delivery to backward point, a sliding stop saves a couple of runs and Maharoof applauds that
good ball boss! He foxes him with the slower ball and it lands on a yorker length, Jayasuriya picks it just in time and manages to drop his bat down to defend, had he misses he would have gone
directs a slower ball on the pads this time and he tucks it just wide of short fine leg, there's protection at the boundary
he opens the face of the bat slightly and shapes it to punch it through the offside, cover picks it up
pitches on a good length on off and cramps him for room, he settles for the gentle push back to the bowler
full and swinging into him, Geeves slides to his left and intercepts a booming on drive, good stuff
the angle is now on off and middle stump, the change in line doesn't work as he clubs it across the line and deposits it over long-on this time

shot! He feeds it full outside the offstump and the length was just ideal for Jayasuriya to go for the slice, the ball shoots off the middle of the bat and just lands over the deep backward point rope
pitches outside off this time and he dabs it wide of backward point
shot! Geeves directs a good length delivery on the pads, he rolls his wrists and tucks it away wide of square leg, the ball travels quickly and fine leg has no chance
full and quick around the offstump, he pushes it firmly through the line and places  it to mid-off
leans forward to drive straight but plays an inside out shot and the edge travels towards backward point
much better, he gets forward to a full and straight delivery and pushes it to mid-off
the margin for error is so minimal against these two, McGrath fails to bowl to his field and slides it on the pads, he gently flicks it and beats short fine leg
gets appreciable movement away from the right hander again, he taps it away wide of backward point, third man is square and he cuts it off
gets the line closer to the right hander, he pushes it back to the bowler
excellent shot! the ball just angles across him and he leans forward and caresses it in the arc between cover and extra cover
lands it full and straight and Jayasuriya biffs it through the line while staying at the crease, one bounce and that was four
slides on his pads and he whips it off one leg but places it straight to short fine leg, McGrath just manages to get down in time to stop it
he bowls in the danger area - Jayasuriya's pads - he picks it and scoops it high over midwicket, that was effortless
gets it to move away from the right hander this time, he drives well away from his body and angles it to third man
just slides down the legside and an excellent slide by Karthik cuts off four wides
gets it to angle across the left hander, he angles it down to third man to take a single
gets plenty of away swing this time, he reaches out and carves it well wide of first slip and the ball races away quickly to third man, the fielder dives in vain
excellent delivery to bowl first up to Sachin, it kicks up off a good length and he stays back and defends
gets quite a bit of swing into the pads and Jayasuriya works it across the line and just beats midwicket, Maharoof misfields but Geeves mops up
fuller in length outside off, he drives towards mid-off
hits a good  length outside off and gets it to climb up. he defends to the offside
scoring opportunity straight away but Jayasuriya flicks a full delivery off his pads to short fine leg

Everyone in the dugout rush onto the field! Nehra keeps it on the stumps and Maharoof takes the risk of backing away and slicing it hard square of the wicket on the offside, there was enough power on that to beat the fielder who tried to boot it away, had he intercepted it the batsmen would have taken two comfortably
if only you could hear the crowd! Nehra overpitches on the pads, he makes room and lofts through the line and almost clears the deep midwicket rope
this is getting more tense here! He makes room to slice through the offside but he misses, good bowling by Nehra
fires a yorker length delivery on off and middle, he drives past the bowler but it's only a single to long-off
takes a couple of paces down the track and lofts it towards long-off
makes room to slice through the offside, he misses
takes the aerial route over extra cover this time and the ball lands safe in the middle of the outfield
bangs it in short this time, Karthik makes room and attempts the upper cut but it doesn't come off
beats him this time, there was width outside off but he missed the glance completely
shot! Nel bowls it full and straight, Karthik stays at the crease and scoops it elegantly offering the full face of the bat, that's a straight six to cherish, and that's his fifty as well
Nel returns for his last over, he bowls it full outside off and he pushes it softly to extra cover
pushed wide of point
gets forward and pushes it wide of cover
he gets better and better! Karthik takes a couple of paces down the track and picks it of his pads, he scoops it over midwicket and Nehra dives in despair to cut it off
he makes room and cuts with the turn to sweeper cover
gets big turn outside off, he makes room and cuts hard square of the wicket

shot! He makes room and creams a fullish delivery past extra cover, Uthappa appears to have it covered but the ball just sneaks past him as he dives, not the best day in the field for all the Mumbai players really, Delhi should win this from here
makes room to biff it past the bowler but he misses it this time
adjusts the line closer to the batsman, he makes room and mistimes it back to the bowler
lovely shot by Maharoof! Kulkarni attempts a yorker outside the offstump, Maharoof backs away and drives it square and beats third man
fullish outside the offstump, he digs it out to cover
Karthik's turning it on here! Kulkarni bowls a high full toss just below the waist and Karthik heaves it away off the meat of the bat and sends it rows back over deep backward square leg
backs away to mow it across the line, he misses
almost a catch! He spoons a good length ball back towards the bowler and Nehra barely had time to react, he manages a smile though
gets behind the line and pushes it firmly off the meat of the bat down to long-on
Maharoof makes room and takes a few paces down the track but the slower delivery beats him
bangs it in short, he swivels and pulls it hard to deep square leg
grants him width outside the offstump, he makes room and cuts it hard backward of point

confusion! He taps a full delivery down towards midwicket and sets off for a single, karthik is content with a single but Tiwary sets off for another run on seeing that the fielder had to cover a lot of ground to get to it, Karthik sends him back at the start but Tiwary isn't listening, Karthik is furious with his partner
what do you know, we have another misfield here.... He mows a full delivery across the line to deep square leg and a fumble allows an extra run
fires it on the blockhole, good comeback by the bowler
Pollock too feels the pressure as he slides it wide down the legside and beats the keeper
varies his pace by bowling a slower ball, he tucks it across the line wide of midwicket
slides doewn the legside, he knew fine leg was in the circle and he flicks it wide of short fine leg, Delhi are suddenly pulling it back fast here
full oiutside off, he shapes to play the slog sweep but the ball races along the turf to long-on
chopped to point
pushed to long-on
catch that in the crowd! Jayasuriya lets a high full toss slip out and Karthik heaves it across the line and gives the crowd at deep midwicket catching practice
he creams a full delivery hard throuygh the line but can't beat the bowler who does well to intercept it
short of a length outside off, he makes room and cuts wide of backward point
moves across his stumps and picks iy across the line and beats square leg
shuffles across his stumps early and improvises well by paddle scooping it over short fine leg, in face it was well wide of any fielder
good shot to ease the pressure, he leans into a full delivery and creams it past mid-off, the fielder was up close and he picked his spot well
fires it full on seeing him give the charge, he forces it to long-on
takes a few paces down and tucks it to square leg
pushed to long-on
makes room and he follows him by spraying it on the pads, he works it to midwicket
gives him the charge and tucks a full delivery wide of midwicket for a couple
pushes a low full toss down to long-on
lovely fielding! Karthik picks it from outside the offstump and slog sweeps it over midwicket, Pollock dives at the boundary and just manages to get a hand to it
steps down and mows it past midwicket, a  misfield by Pollock allows an extra run, Mumbai are a bit sloppy here
leans forward to push a full delivery across the line and meets it low on the pad, they appeal but theball may have missed leg
angles a full delivery on his pads and he whips it confidently down to fine leg
that's two in two! Pitches on offstump and holds its line, Dilshan tries to force it wide of cover but plays outside the line of the ball, the ball skids through and the offstump is flattened
pitched up on middle and off, he shapes to cart this one over long-on but fails to get the desired elevation, Chitnis cups it just inches in front of the rope
pushed back to the bowler
Dropped: He drives it hard and full back to the bowler and Smith fumbles as the ball heads straight towards his face
slides down the legside, he misses the glance
charges down the track to cart it over mid-off but gets a thick under edge which beats the stumps, the fielder runs back from short fine leg and cuts it off
rocks back at the crease and pulls over midwicket, the fielder runs across and mops it up
stays back at the crease and he punches a ball that keeps a little low, Uthappa could have taken the catch if he was more alert
pitched on middle, he gets forward and defends
bowls that too wide outside off, he makes room and then reaches out and glides it with control down to squarish third man
slides on the pads, he works it off his hips wide of square leg
full outside off, he swings and misses
an uppish punch just falls short of Uthappa at backward point
misfield! Tiwary pulls a shortish delivery across the line and Nel makes a mess of it at long-on, he fails to get down to properly to pick  it up
shuffles across his stumps but fails to adjust to the ball which kicks up and beats the outside edge
stays back at the crease and punches it with an open face down to third man
sprays it really wide outside the offstump
gets a leading edge to the offside and a fumble allows a single
makes room and mistimes a punch down to cover
taps it in front of mid-off and sets off for a single
holds the length back after seeing him coming down the track, Dhawan fails to execute the pull properly and the top edge falls well short of the bowler, that was a mishit
grants him a bit of width outside off and he punches it uppishly past backward point and doen to third man
not quite the best of deliveries, he slides on his pads and he glances it down to fine leg, the fielder mops it up
taps it softly in front of point, they think of a single but Dhawan sends him back
fires in a yorker from around the wicket, he gets his bat down and digs it out to the offside for a single
drifts towards his body and he tucks it behind square on the on side
that was pitched up and in the slot to drive, Tiwary makes room and lofts it elegantly wide of mid-off, Nel knows he's bowled a poor ball
on the leg stump, Dhawan looks to pull it and gets an under edge to short fine leg for a single
short and width given outside the off stump, Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball and slashes hard at it as it travels past point for a boundary
on the off stump, comes forward and drives it back to the bowler

Kulkarni overpitches it this time around as Tiwary plonks his frontfoot forward and   
slaps it to midwicket for a boundary
short of a length delivery on the middle stump, Dhawan turns it to midwicket for a single
on the middle stump, Dhawan drives it back to the bowler
on a good length outside the off stump, Tiwary comes forward and has a push at it. Utthappa misfields at cover to gift a single
beats him with an off cutter outside the off stump
fuller outside the off stump, Dhawan drives it to mid off but does not take any run

fuller on the middle stump, Gambhir gets under it and lofts it away. It goes pretty high up in the air and takes long time to come down, but not for one moment did Smith take his eyes off the ball as he comes up with a good catch. Nel has his man finally
fuller in length outside the off stump, Dhawan steers it to short third man for a single
on the leg stump, Gambhir pushes it to square leg for a single
Gambhir goes one better this time as he lofts it away to third man boundary for a six as Nel isn't amused
full outside the off stump, Gambhir drives it past point for a boundary
fuller outside the off stump, Dhawan uncorks the drive now but does not get it past the fielder at cover
fuller length delivery on the middle stump, Gmabhir pushes it to mid on for a single
on a good length on the middle stump, Dhawan looks to pull it away but gets a bottom edge to square leg for a single
short outside the off stump, Dhawan backs away and looks to cut it but misses the line of the ball altogether
on a good length outside the off stump, pushes it to point
on the middle stump, Gambhir pushes it to mid on with soft hands for a single
he wrecks a potential maiden over by shuffling across his stumps and whipping it high over deep fine leg, that landed a few rows back
takes a couple of paces down the track but can't beat  Pollock
and another dot, Dhawan tries to pierce the offside field this time but he pushes it to mid-off
he shapes to cream this through the onside but doesn't quite pick the slower ball as he mistimes the drive to mid-on
bowls the slower ball, he pushes it back to the bowler
hits a good length on offstump, he pushes it to mid-off

take cover! Gambhir lets his intentions known by making room, he picks a good length delivery swinging away from him and creams that high over extra cover, that raced to the boundary at the sped of light
pitches around the offstump, he plays with an angled bat and steers it doen to third man
gets a half stride forward and pushes it through the line to mid-off
grants him a bit of width outside off, he makes use of the pace and movement of the ball to dab it with control wide of slip and down to third man

that legstump takes a walk! Sehwag walks across his stumps early to whip it fine, Nehra lands it on a good length on middle and leg and just gets it to drift away, the ball brushes Sehwag's hip and takes out the legstump
walks down the track early and Nehra tucks him up by banging it in short, he taps it beside him and sets off quickly
angling into his body, Sehwag intelligently shuffles across his stumps and whips it well wide of short fine leg, that's 19 off the over
shot! The ball pitches on middle stump and holds its line, Sehwag stays at the crease and plays a front foot pull over deep midwicket, that lands a few rows back
makes room and carves a slower delivery high over the bowler's head, it appeared as if he didn't control it but the stroke was safe, the ball just lands in front of the rope
pitches on a fullish length outside off and he fetches it away from his body and hoicks it past midwicket, not convincing but effective
pitches on middle and comes on straight, he taps it back to the bowler

circumspect start already for Delhi, Gambhir pushes it towards cover and sets off, Sehwag sends him back and Uthappa's throw just misses the stumps, had he hit Gambhir would have gone, thay take a run of the overthrow
